items.text: We have some brief but important news for you today, so pause your demolition tasks for a moment and listen up, everyone! 👂

You informed us about the freezing issues following the latest patch, so we got to work right away! Thanks to your reports, we were able to prepare and release a quick hotfix to resolve the problem. Thank you to all who helped us in this process!
• Fixed game freeze when trying to skip time in player HQ

As always, thank you all, demolishers, for your awesome feedback and factual, useful reports on issues encountered. As always, we remain at your disposal on our Discord server, Social Media channels and Steam Discussions! More fixes, patches and updates are on their way, so stay tuned 📢

The roar of engines and the rumble of cracking walls are still present on the construction site, as our work to improve and enhance D&B3 continues 👷‍♂️ Today we come to you with the brand-new Patch 1.04, which is mainly based on your reports, feedback and suggestions. As always - we are extremely grateful for them all!
The changes we're about to tell you about include both QOL improvements and important bug fixes that you've brought to our attention. Sounds good? Let's dive right in! 👇
• Added a new option to reset the player character's position (via the escape menu)
• Added a new option to bring additional tools or vehicles after starting a job:

To add new tools or vehicles to the job, use the laptop at the back of your pickup truck. Add new ones as you did before starting the job. Just make sure the drop-off points are not blocked by anything. Example of a drop-off point: • Added a new animation when using the "skip time" option: • Fixes to demolished elements falling through the ground: • Fixed a bug with incorrect illumination of the buildings at night: • Fixed a bug that caused pouring concrete to create mounds of soil: • Fixed a bug with missing translations for picking up/dropping the light tower: • A number of other minor fixes

items.text: Yours faithfully,

A few days ago we published the very first Hotfix to the game, and we’re keeping up the momentum! 🤓 Based on your feedback, we managed to prepare another update in which we are improving several important gameplay elements.

notes.title: A word about controls and camera options

items.text: However, before we dive into the Hotfix Notes, we want to assure you that we’ve heard your thoughts on control and camera operation issues loud and clear. We are currently carefully analyzing your feedback and collecting every bit of useful information in order to plan and implement appropriate changes 👷‍♂️

Today's Hotfix is ​​the first step to improve these aspects and make the game even more intuitive and enjoyable. That is why it's full of changes developed based on your requests. We really hope that you will like all the novelties we have prepared for you!

If you would like to support us in our mission to further improve D&B3, please share your suggestions and ideas on our Discord server, or simply describe your experiences in the comments of this entry. Any input will be greatly appreciated! And now...
• Adjustments to the mini-excavator arm rotation speed to make them more precise
Camera now always turns along with the vehicle
Fixed jittering
Camera no longer goes below ground level
Smoother zoom operation
When in operator mode, each attachment has its own camera focus points
Camera Y axis is no longer inverted by default (requires setting change in the Main Menu)

Camera is now generally more responsive and intuitive: • When entering the vehicle, the position of the 1st and 3rd person cameras and the driving mode are reset: • The mini-excavator and excavator grappler can now be used to demolish less durable kinds of materials
reduced sliding
smoother turning
slightly increased bucket size

Stiffer vehicle-arm connections (more stability when performing actions): • Increased turn speed of large excavator: • Changed default key bindings in excavators, the up arrow now raises the arm (requires setting change in the Main Menu - set default)
when in options, you will see options of the last used controller
when in escape-menu, you will see options of the vehicle currently in use
new shortcuts for better navigation

new option to assign different inputs to positive and negative axis poles (for ex. right pedal to move forward and left pedal to move backward): • Hand tools now meet the requirements of assets assigned to a mission before starting it; a section with recommended tools has been added to the mission details window
Dig Out Old Wires - the number of cables has been reduced, the ground is now deeper and easier to dig, the cables are now easier to grip

Demolish a Single Wall - removal of the penalty for damaging furniture, the protective board removed: • Fixed low FPS issue (due to too many messages) when in the laptop screen: • Minor fixes to the physics (collisions between broken fragments, fragments sinking into the ground)

As you can see, Hotfix 1.02 introduces many important changes, but our work is still in progress. In subsequent updates, we have planned to implement improvements such as the option to import additional assets after starting a mission, resetting the player character, and further extensions to the keyboard binding option. More info on this topic coming soon!

Thank you all, demolishers, for your awesome feedback and factual, useful reports on issues encountered. As always, we remain at your disposal on our Discord server, Social Media channels and Steam Discussions! More fixes, patches and updates are on their way, so stay tuned 📢

items.text: We hope you've had a good time with Demolish & Build 3 so far, everyone! While listening to your feedback and opinions, we realized that some of you were experiencing problems with resetting vehicles and using the Saw attachments effectively 👷‍♂️

That's why our team took immediate action to fix these two problems, resulting in today's (very first!) Hotfix! 🧐 You can expect to see more of such fixes, updates and patches in the future, as we continue to analyze your reports and explore how can we further improve our game. But now - let's get back to the topic.
• Fixed a bug where resetting the vehicle in 3rd person view and exiting it would cause it to become stuck
• The power of all types of Saws (i.e. attachments of this type) has been increased
• Number of other minor fixes

At this point, it is worth noting that we are already working on the following fixes that will address issues such as: improvements to the camera work (jittering and changes to the 3rd person view), using grappler in demolition tasks, and tweaks to the physics of destruction.

More information on this coming soon, so be sure to stay tuned! 📢 Thank you all, demolishers, for your awesome feedback and factual, useful reports on issues encountered. As always, we remain at your disposal on our Discord server, Social Media channels and Steam Discussions!

releases.displayName: Update demo - full customization for controllers/joysticks/steering wheels

notes.title: Many of you have asked for the addition of full optimization for controllers. Especially for you, we have prepared an update related to these changes. As of now, you can assign any function to a button or axis in our demo - Demolish & Build 3: Excavator Playground.

items.text: We took great care to create a system that is both flexible and easy to use. With it you can use any number and any type of controllers. Also, we did our best to allow you to assign whatever button or axis to every important function. In the future we will also add options to calibrate and fine-tune your axes to give you the best experience you can have.
⦁ This button allows you to remove the current assignment.
⦁ To assign a button select a function…
… and press the chosen button. Only buttons from the selected controller will be pooled. You can also assign an axis as a button (for ex. LT/RT on a controller).
⦁ To assign an axis, first select chosen function from the list
⦁ There are 4 modes available: Axis, Buttons, Axis with a modifier, Buttons with a modifier
⦁ Axis/Buttons
To assign simply select the function and use chosen axis or button
⦁ Axis/Buttons with Modifier

Axis/Buttons with Modifier is a special function that allows you to use the same controller axis for multiple functions. In practice, the Modifier works like a Shift Key – pressing it will override the default function and use this one instead.
Let’s use this method to setup the Xbox 360 controller to the SAE pattern instead of the default ISO.
For the sake of this presentation, we’ll use an empty layout but you can just as easily modify an existing one.
⦁ Assign the RT/RB to the right track
⦁ Select right track forward
⦁ Select no binding and press RT to assign it
⦁ Return to the list
⦁ Select the right track backward
⦁ Choose BUTTONS mode
⦁ Select no binding next to RIGHT TRACK BACKWARD + and assign RB
⦁ Repeat the same for the left track
⦁ Select rotate cabin (left, right), axis mode, and assign left stick X (horizontal) axis.
⦁ Select rotate boom (up, down), axis mode, and assign left stick Y (vertical) axis.
⦁ Now, let’s move on to the right stick. Select extend attachment, axis mode, and assign right stick X axis.
⦁ Select rotate arm (up, down), axis mode, and assign right stick Y axis.
⦁ We also need to rotate the shears
⦁ Select rotate attachment horizontally
⦁ Change mode to BUTTONS
⦁ Assign D-Pad left/right to the appropriate functions
⦁ That leaves us with camera controls. Since we’ve already assigned all controller axes we’ll use the modifier.
⦁ Select rotate camera
⦁ Choose AXIS WITH MODIFIER mode
⦁ First assign the left stick button to the MODIFIER
⦁ Now let’s assign the right stick axes to both functions
This means that when we press the right stick button the left stick will control the camera instead of the excavator’s left joystick.
⦁ Repeat the same steps for camera zoom with the right stick button and left stick y.
That’s it. We’ve created working SAE controls for our controller from scratch.
Some additional rules/tips when creating custom control schemes:
⦁ A single axis can be assigned to only one function without modifiers.
⦁ You cannot use the same button for the modifier and a normal function.
⦁ On the other hand, a button can be used as a modifier for multiple functions.
⦁ You do not have to assign every function for a single controller.
⦁ If you want to assign a full axis to one of the tracks, best assign it to the left/right track forward functions.
